title: GenNVS: Geometry-enhanced Novel View Synthesis via Disentangled 3D Prior
abstract: arXiv:2609.34579v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Single-image novel view synthesis remains challenging because the underlying 3D geometry is highly ambiguous. Recent diffusion-based approaches produce plausible results, but they often struggle to preserve the geometric structure and spatial coherence of foreground objects. We present GenNVS, a framework for geometry-enhanced novel view synthesis via a disentangled 3D prior. Specifically, GenNVS models foreground objects and the background with 3D Gaussian Splatting and aligns them through a coarse-to-fine geometric optimization process to form a unified 3D scene. This scene conditions a video diffusion model through the proposed Dual-Stream Masking mechanism, which guides synthesis by jointly exploiting rendered validity masks and geometry-aware warping. translated_title: GenNVS：通过解耦3D先验实现几何增强的新视角合成
translated_abstract: 单图像新视角合成仍然具有挑战性，因为其底层的3D几何结构高度模糊。近期基于扩散模型的方法能够产生看似合理的结果，但它们往往难以保持前景物体的几何结构和空间一致性。我们提出了GenNVS，一个通过解耦3D先验实现几何增强的新视角合成框架。具体而言，GenNVS使用3D高斯泼溅对前景物体和背景进行建模，并通过由粗到细的几何优化过程将二者对齐，从而形成一个统一的3D场景。该场景通过所提出的双流掩码机制对视频扩散模型进行条件约束，通过联合利用渲染的有效性掩码和几何感知的扭曲变换来引导合成过程。实验结果表明，GenNVS在视觉质量和几何精度方面均优于近期方法，同时自然地支持灵活的场景编辑。
tldr: 提出GenNVS框架，利用解耦的3D高斯泼溅先验和双流掩码机制对视频扩散模型进行条件约束，在单图像新视角合成中同时提升了视觉质量与几何精度。
en_tdlr: GenNVS proposes a geometry-enhanced novel view synthesis framework that leverages disentangled 3D Gaussian Splatting priors and a Dual-Stream Masking mechanism to condition a video diffusion model, improving both visual quality and geometric accuracy in single-image novel view synthesis.
